verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the marketplace app GitHub for Atlassian, which claims to sync development and automate workflows between GitHub and Jira. That implies linking commits to an external issue tracker, but only through an add-on, and the pack never says that referencing issue keys in commits changes issue statuses. GitHub's own issues and projects are described only vaguely as tools that 'adapt to your code'. Missing for 10: documented native support for referencing issues in commits (e.g. closing keywords) that updates issue status, explicit evidence that commit issue keys move Jira or other tracker statuses, hands-on or independent corroboration.
